examples.english: A roar of laughter broke out in the venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{哄笑|こうしょう}し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}いた→叩く：02072_tataku⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あまり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}くて→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧、⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧{中|じゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{哄笑|こうしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: His story was so funny that the entire classroom was engulfed in laughter.

notes:
Describes loud, uninhibited laughter from a group or an individual. Has a literary or written register — in casual conversation, people would use ⟦{大笑|おおわら}い→大笑い：15938_oowarai⟧ or ⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}→爆笑：08686_bakushou⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {哄笑|こうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a roar of laughter breaks out
- {哄笑|こうしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be engulfed in laughter
- {哄笑|こうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誘|さそ}う→誘う：01947_sasou⟧: to provoke laughter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}→爆笑：08686_bakushou⟧: explosive laughter — colloquial and very common; implies sudden, uncontrollable laughter
- ⟦{大笑|おおわら}い→大笑い：15938_oowarai⟧: big laugh — casual and friendly; the everyday way to say a hearty laugh
- ⟦{失笑|しっしょう}→失笑：08689_shisshou⟧: involuntary laugh — laughing despite trying not to; often misused to mean scornful laughter
